title: Expedition 12
description: Explore a wide world with new biomes, dimensions, and monsters to discover and slay!
body:
Expedition 12 throws you into a world full of discovery!

(This is a port of my [Curseforge Version](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/expedition-12) of my modpack to Modrinth. Some mods are outright removed from this version due to them not existing in the Modrinth Mods page, therefore, couldn't exactly add them. If you wish to find the Curseforge Version, join the discord)

Many popular magic mods such as Twilight Forest and Fire & Ice have been added, allowing users wanting an RPG element as you discover the new world. Oceans up to 3x their normal depth with leviathans lurking in the deep, to soaring high mountains with towers and dungeons to uncover!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/U5d-_ily148" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Some other mod enhancements are as follows:

-Optimizations 

-Overhauled vanilla structures

-Vanilla+ structures to enjoy

-Optional choice to play with friends via e4mc mod

This is the Standard Edition of EXP12. The Hunters Edition which adds some various extra mods to add a spin on the idea of sneaking around the world trying to avoid death, you now become death.

The Hunters Edition can be found [Here!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/expedition-12-hunters-edition)
Join the Discord to see more packs Ive made and to join the community [here](https://discord.gg/AJXhhxGR6q)

Comments are appreciated for suggestions on more mods that will bring the feel of exploration!
